doc.title: Stefon Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2020

title: Video availability and goodbyes
summary: Michelle announces when the Hamilton video streams, and everyone thanks one another and signs off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: So a word about the video is that as you may know Stefon Harris and Blackout were scheduled to perform live at Hamilton College in Wellin Hall last April and that did not happen. So we were lucky enough to be able to ask them to record the entire band got together at Rutgers University and that video will be available for three days starting on Friday the 13th at 7:30 P.M. You can go to Hamilton.edu/performing arts for a link. And I’m so happy that we were able to create that for our viewers. It’s free to watch and also free to share with your friends because we’d like the whole world to see it for the three days that it’s available.
Thank you for the work you’re doing to keep the music alive and it really is something that we all need right now.

Thank you, I would agree. And thank you for the work that you’re doing to keep the music alive. So I think we’re out of time. This goes until 12:50, we have students maybe who need to get back to class and people that need to get back to their desks. So thank you very much, Monk and Stefon for taking the time to talk to each other and to let us listen in. It was fantastic. I feel like I’ve learned so much in this hour. So thank you and enjoy the rest of your day, enjoy your weekend and be well.
Okay thank you. Over and out.
